intro: Football and basketball are Israel's most popular sports. Israeli teams compete in European competitions.

chapters.title: Basketball
text: Maccabi Tel Aviv has won the EuroLeague six times, and Deni Avdija plays in the NBA.

chapters.title: Olympics and more
text: Israel's Olympic golds have come in windsurfing and gymnastics. In 1972, eleven Israeli athletes and coaches were murdered by Palestinian militants at the Munich Olympics.

items.title: Israeli Premier League
